parts.html: The K-30 kitchen is a modern L-shaped design that combines white upper cabinets with solid gray fronts on the remaining units. The two-tone composition visually divides the furniture into a light upper tier and a more expressive lower section while preserving a unified, minimalist character in the interior.

The white upper section reflects natural light and makes the kitchen look less bulky. The gray lower cabinets create a calm base that pairs well with light wall finishes, ceramic tile, wood textures, and stone-look surfaces. This design suits modern apartments, condos, and private homes, including open-plan kitchen and living areas.

The key layout feature of the K-30 is its L-shaped configuration. The kitchen furniture runs along two adjacent walls, making use of the corner space and distributing work surfaces between two sections. Depending on the room layout, the sink, cooktop, refrigerator, and other functional zones can be conveniently positioned.

The total length of the model is 4.2 linear meters, and the overall dimensions of the standard composition are 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m. The L-shaped layout makes room for storage and a work zone without a separate kitchen island. The placement of built-in appliances is agreed upon during custom design, taking into account utility connections and room dimensions.

Both upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard. The upper row of cabinets has a solid white finish, while the lower and remaining fronts are gray. The standard model does not include a woodgrain decor: the main design feature of the K-30 is the combination of two neutral colors.

The kitchen carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based. This specification preserves the integrity of the furniture composition and allows it to be adapted to specific room dimensions.

Hinged doors are fitted with Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms. Pull-out elements run on Muller telescopic slides without soft-close mechanisms. Cabinet handles are included in the standard configuration. Lift-up mechanisms and a cargo pull-out are not included.

The K-30 kitchen can be adapted in terms of functionality and materials. At the client’s request, more functional cabinet hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems can be installed. Alternative materials are also available, from more budget-friendly to premium options. With a custom order, you can choose the front finishes, countertop material, and cabinet interior fittings to match your preferences and project budget.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-30 can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room by changing the length of the furniture runs and the placement of cabinets, the work surface, and built-in appliances. During the design process, you can choose shades of white and gray, front and countertop materials, cabinet hardware, and storage systems.

We offer a comprehensive approach: furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be supplied with a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
